text: パソコンから　＊を　＊に　もたせ　もっていた　＊を　バッグに　しまった！

structure.jp: バッグに　しまった！

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せ in the verb turns 'hold' into 'make or let someone hold', and に shows who is made to hold. ＊に　もたせ = 'had ＊ hold it'.

patterns.name: 〜ます stem (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut off at its stem, without ます or て, joins on to the next action like 'and'; it is the written-style version of the て form. もたせ = 'had it hold, and'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a thing describes that thing, like 'that' in English. もっていた　＊ = 'the ＊ that it had been holding'.
